headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.defectStationaryJointLaw_uniform
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.defectStationaryJointLaw r c U L = OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalJoinedWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit T hTerm : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalJoinedWord r c U L hr hc start N hIn J hExit T hTerm) =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc start N hIn J hExit T hTerm

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalJoinedLaw_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)]
  (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit T hTerm : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc start N hIn J hExit T hTerm)
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.walkLaw
          (fun d => Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit) start T)
        (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.defectStationaryLaw r c U L) +
      Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic hTerm

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.scheduledTerminalJoinedWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
          ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (t T hTerm : ℕ),
            ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalJoinedWord r c U L hr hc start (t + 2) (t + 2)
                      (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
                      (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
                      T hTerm))
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
              ↑T * ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t) +
                  Math115.PhysicalFiniteWalk.massAllowance r U L *
                    Real.exp (-↑T / Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.aggregateMixingAllowance r c U) +
                ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic hTerm)
